output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply and mintedAmount parameters are not checked for overflow, allowing the owner to set the total supply to a very high value, granting arbitrary tokens to any user.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; line can overflow if _value is very large, causing it to wrap around and become very small, allowing attackers to steal funds.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; line can overflow if _value is very large, causing it to wrap around and become very small, allowing attackers to steal funds.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowance[_spender][msg.sender] = _value; line can overflow if _value is very large, causing it to wrap around and become very small, allowing attackers to steal funds.
The receiveApproval function has a wrong logic vulnerability. It does not check if the contract is frozen, allowing attackers to bypass the freezeAccount function and steal funds.
